conventions: Paths are relative to the repo root. Line numbers were read at HEAD 3efed60 (2026-11-03, «App: record a meeting and get notes and a task»), the commit both reviews read (.claude/ux-review/runs/2026-11-03-screens/review-C.md and review-D.md). Search for the code a line points at if another package's merge has moved it.
Branch: this run works on claude/project-thread-xqvgpc, not dev (the owner's thread workflow is a PR into main, which the main session opens; no package pushes, merges or touches main).

Packages run as the machine allows, each in its own worktree; at most two change one file at once, and the merge brings their edits together. The ARB catalogs, lib/l10n/generated/ and test files don't count as shared. Shared files this run: App/lib/screens/meeting_screen.dart (P321, P322, P323, P324), App/lib/services/meeting_controller.dart (P320, P323, P324, P325), App/lib/widgets/meeting_banners.dart (P320, P321, P322), App/lib/services/meeting_recorder.dart (P323, P324, P325), App/lib/services/meeting_audio.dart (P323, P325), App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart (P318, P321, P325), App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart (P318, P319). Each package changes only the hunks its brief names in a shared file; don't reformat, reorder or rename anything else there.

Copy is exact, shown as ES, EN and CA. EN copy sits between “ ”; ES and CA between « ». Keep the catalogs' marks: ’ in English and Catalan (as the meeting strings already use), «…» in Spanish and Catalan, … as one character (U+2026). Every new string goes in all three ARB files (App/docs/LOCALIZATION.md); run flutter gen-l10n after an ARB change and never edit lib/l10n/generated/. The catalogs merge key by key between packages: add or change only the keys your brief names, add new keys next to the other meeting keys, and don't reorder or reformat others. A key two packages both need is owned by one of them, and the other depends on it (P324 reuses P322's `meetingMakeNotes`).

Owner decisions bind every package (.claude/ux-review/DECISIONS.md and App/docs/MEETING_NOTES.md). The build's own defaults until the owner says otherwise (owner context, 2026-11-03): meeting notes are Pro only; no consent reminder; the 7-day auto-finish (MN-26) and the 30-day server sweep (MN-27). MN-13 (signing out never silently drops a recording; a failed send keeps the account signed in), MN-22 (one tap to a task through the existing review, unticking what isn't wanted), MN-26 (a real meeting is never thrown away silently) and MN-12 (a recording that stopped by itself offers continue, make notes or discard) are requirements. D2 (reminders off by default; the notification permission asked only from the first dated task's sheet and Ajustes) stands: no package adds a permission request (that is D3 of this plan, UX-2813). The capture flow (D3 of 2026-10-13, D12) is unchanged for dictations.

Still open, so no package changes them: which notes show «Crear tarea» (UX-2722; `noteMakesTask`, App/lib/widgets/note_task.dart:15-16, stays as it is); whether free accounts see «Grabar una reunión» (UX-2719; it keeps showing to everyone and opening the Pro screen); stating the monthly meeting time (UX-2720); a consent or audio-retention line (UX-2721); a notification ask at the first meeting (UX-2813); the notes-ready notification on the lock screen (UX-2814); the RevenueCat paywall (UX-2815, external).

Backend/ is out of scope, and so is anything that changes what the server stores or receives. P318's note → task link is phone-local, in the existing `app_preferences` table, with no schema change, and is never synced or sent.
Subtract first. No new settings, screens, tabs or concepts. New copy only where a brief gives it.

Out of scope: another session's uncommitted work, .claude/ux-web/, Backend/, App/pubspec.yaml, App/scripts/, App/config/, App/android/ (no native change this run), the root build/ and scripts/ folders, and the plugin registrant files under App/linux, App/macos and App/windows that `flutter pub get` modifies. Don't edit, format or stage any of them.

Tests: the implementer keeps the suite passing, runs the tests of the files it touched in one call, and updates only the tests its change rightly breaks (say which in your notes). ux-tester writes the acceptance tests afterwards and reads copy through the generated AppLocalizations. Put a package's new tests in a group named for it (for example `group('P318 · …', …)`) at the end of the file's main(): test files merge between packages line by line. Harnesses: App/test/meeting_screens_test.dart and App/test/support/meeting_screen_fakes.dart (the meeting screens, Notes lines, the note and «Crear tarea»; `ScriptedMeetings`, `meetingsOverride`), App/test/meeting_core_test.dart and App/test/support/meeting_fakes.dart (controller, recorder, store, uploader), App/test/meeting_sign_out_test.dart (Cuenta › Cerrar sesión with meetings), App/test/meeting_open_note_test.dart (the notes-ready tap), App/test/reminder_notification_id_test.dart (notification ids and details), App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart (the capture sheet), App/test/notes_ui_test.dart (the Notes tab), App/test/subscription_screen_test.dart (the Pro screen).

Sizes: 2× means TextScaler.linear(2.0); 360×800 and 360×740 are views at devicePixelRatio 1. Tests that measure a fit load Manrope, as new_task_form_test.dart does. The preview suite scales linearly, while Android 14+ scales non-linearly: a label that wraps only at linear 2× isn't a failure on a phone.

Renders: from App/, `flutter test --no-pub --dart-define=WRITE_UX_PREVIEWS=true test/ux_previews/ux_previews_test.dart --plain-name "meetings/"` (or notes/, settings/) refreshes those PNGs with INDEX.md and AUDIT.md. The meeting previews are in App/test/ux_previews/meeting_previews.dart, the Notes tab's in notes_previews.dart, the Pro screen's in settings_previews.dart. Re-render what your package changes, add the states your brief asks for, and keep each preview's description true to what it now shows.

Environment: a Linux cloud container (Flutter at /home/claude/tools/flutter/bin) with no Android SDK, emulator or phone. No agent touches a device, runs the backend or calls the AI. Device checks are for the owner's phone; nothing here is phone evidence.
Judge every screen as a first-time, non-technical user would, in Spanish, often at large text: the owner's father.

packages.title: «Crear tarea» from a note: choose the steps, land on the new task, leave without a question, and make it the main button
brief: Context: «Crear tarea» (MN-22) is `createTaskFromNote` (App/lib/widgets/note_task.dart:23-75). It writes a capture session (source 'typed', status 'ready', one draft titled like the note with the note's open steps as its checklist) and opens `showCaptureSheet(captureId:, startListening: false, useScope: false)`, so it inherits the dictation review's checkbox meaning, its leave question and its landing. Four findings sit on that path, and this package fixes them together. Which notes show the button is an open owner question (UX-2722): don't change `noteMakesTask` (note_task.dart:15-16).

Mark these captures. Create the session with `source: 'note'` (note_task.dart:41). Wherever `source` is read, 'note' behaves as 'typed' does today: voice_task_screen.dart only compares it with 'speech' and 'shared', and App/lib/services/capture_processor.dart:235 already sends 'typed' for anything not spoken (don't edit capture_processor.dart). `CaptureStore.pending` (App/lib/services/capture_store.dart) never returns a 'note' session, and deletes any it finds (one left by an app killed during the review), so these never reach «Sin guardar», the Notes tab's «N sin guardar» line or the captures screen.

UX-2706 (S2), leaving: today Cancel, Back and a swipe down ask `captureKeepTextQuestion` («¿Conservar el texto para más tarde?», with a red «Descartar»), through `_leave` (voice_task_screen.dart:4402-4425) and `_askToKeep` (:377-389), and «Conservar» parks a copy of the note in «Sin guardar». For a 'note' session, Cancel, Back, a swipe down and a tap above the sheet close it at once with no question and delete the session, as `_discard` does. The note itself never changes. Every other capture keeps the question exactly as now.

UX-2701 (S3), choosing the steps: today each tick in the review marks a step done (App/lib/widgets/checklist_editor.dart:149-167), so the task is saved with the chosen steps already completed, and leaving one out takes ⋮ › «Eliminar paso» (:200-221). MN-22 asks for a select model. In a 'note' review only: (a) the steps start ticked, under the heading ES «Pasos que se añaden» / EN “Steps to add” / CA «Passos que s’afegeixen», which replaces «Pasos · 0/3» (`checklistCount`) there; (b) a tick means the step goes into the task, and unticking leaves it out; (c) the rows have no ⋮ (no rename, reorder or remove); the add-step field stays, and a step typed there starts ticked; (d) each checkbox's TalkBack label stays the step's title. Build it as a mode of `ChecklistEditor` (checklist_editor.dart:9-21), for example `choosing: true` (default false), passed by `CaptureReviewEditor` (App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:812 and :933) when the sheet's session has source 'note' (thread the flag from the sheet). To hold «kept», the note's steps can start with done set (note_task.dart:50-53, `ChecklistItem(title: …).setDone(true)`): they are all open on the note, so done means nothing else in this draft. Then `_save` (voice_task_screen.dart:3364), for a 'note' session only, drops the unticked steps and saves the ticked ones in order as open steps (done false). A task made from a note never has a step done. Other reviews and the task form keep today's checklist exactly: ⋮, «Pasos · n/N», and the checkbox meaning done.

UX-2702 (S3), where it lands: today «Añadir tarea» closes the sheet back onto the note, sets Calendar's focus where nobody is looking (voice_task_screen.dart:4140-4170), shows «Añadida sin fecha · Deshacer» at the edge, and the note still offers «Crear tarea», so a second tap makes a second identical task. For a 'note' session: close the sheet, then push the new task's page, `TaskDetailScreen(taskId: <the new task's id>)` (App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart:23), on the navigator under the sheet, so Back returns to the note. Don't set `calendarFocusProvider` and don't open a project page for it. The snackbar keeps its message and «Deshacer»; «Deshacer» deletes the task as now, and if that task's page is on top it closes, back on the note.

UX-2702, the note remembers its task: keep a phone-local link from the note to the task it made, in the existing `app_preferences` table (scope for example `note-task:<ownerKey>:<noteId>`, data the task's id), as App/lib/providers/free_voice_notice_provider.dart stores its notice: no schema change, not synced, nothing sent. While that task exists (in taskProvider and not deleted; a completed task still counts), the note's button reads ES «Ver tarea» / EN “View task” / CA «Mostra la tasca» and opens that task's page. When the task is gone (deleted, undone), the button is «Crear tarea» again and the link may be removed. On another phone the note shows «Crear tarea»; that's accepted.

UX-2709 (S2), the main button: on a note's page the bottom bar has a filled «Editar nota» (142×60 dp) beside an outlined «Crear tarea» (144×56 dp) (task_detail_screen.dart:563-580). When the note offers «Crear tarea» or «Ver tarea», that button is the `FilledButton.icon`, first in the row, and «Editar nota» becomes an `OutlinedButton.icon` after it; both have the same height (give both the filled button's height). A note without «Crear tarea» keeps its filled «Editar nota» alone, as now.
New keys (all three ARB files): the review heading («Pasos que se añaden»), «Ver tarea». No other copy changes; `meetingCreateTask` stays «Crear tarea».

Don't touch: `noteMakesTask`, App/lib/screens/notes_screen.dart, the meeting files, capture_processor.dart, the task form (App/lib/widgets/task_editor.dart), the note page's body and steps above the bottom bar (P321 changes their order; build on whatever is there), and the leave question, checkbox and landing of every capture that isn't from a note.

Previews (meeting_previews.dart): re-render `meetings/note.review` and `meetings/note.create-task`, and add `meetings/note.after-task.es.light.1x` (the note once its task exists: «Ver tarea» filled, «Editar nota» outlined). Update App/test/meeting_screens_test.dart:857-920, which stops before saving and asserts the leave dialog at :906-919.
acceptance: UX-2701: Pro, ES 1× on 360×800, a note with three open steps → «Crear tarea»: the review shows the heading «Pasos que se añaden», all three steps ticked, and no ⋮ button on any step row.
UX-2701: in that review, untick the second step and tap «Añadir tarea»: the saved task's checklist is exactly steps 1 and 3, in that order, both open (not done). No step of the saved task is done.
UX-2701: a step typed in that review's add field starts ticked and is saved as an open step.
UX-2701: a dictated capture's review and the task form still show «Pasos · n/N» and ⋮, and their checkbox still marks a step done (existing tests pass unchanged).
UX-2702: after «Añadir tarea» from a note's review, the top route is TaskDetailScreen for the new task; one Back shows the note; Calendar's focus (`calendarFocusProvider`) was not set by the save.
UX-2702: back on the note, the bottom bar shows «Ver tarea» and no «Crear tarea»; tapping «Ver tarea» opens that same task's page, and the number of tasks is unchanged.
UX-2702: «Deshacer» in the snackbar deletes the new task and closes its page if on top; the note shows «Crear tarea» again. Deleting the made task from its page has the same result on the note.

UX-2706: in a note's review, Cancelar closes the sheet with no dialog; so does Back. The capture session is gone from the store, and `pendingCapturesProvider` holds the same captures as before «Crear tarea» was tapped.
UX-2706: a 'note' session left in the store (as after the app was killed) is not returned by `CaptureStore.pending` and doesn't show in «Sin guardar».

UX-2709: on a note with open steps at ES 1× and 2× and CA 2× (360×800), «Crear tarea» is a FilledButton, first, and «Editar nota» an OutlinedButton; their heights differ by at most 1 dp. A note with no steps shows only a filled «Editar nota».
All new copy exists in EN, ES and CA through AppLocalizations.
deviceChecks: Phone, Spanish: a meeting's note › «Crear tarea» › untick one step › «Añadir tarea»: the task's page opens with the kept steps open; Back shows the note with «Ver tarea». Cancel from the review closes with no question, and nothing appears under «Sin guardar» after reopening the app.

packages.title: While a meeting records, every capture entry types instead of reaching for the microphone
brief: UX-2704 (S3): nothing outside the meeting files knows that a meeting recorder holds the microphone. Notes' «Añadir nota» keeps its mic while «Grabando una reunión · 12:03» shows above it (App/lib/screens/notes_screen.dart:303-317; render `meetings/notes-lines.recording.es.light.1x`). Calendar's and Tareas' «Añadir tarea», the home-screen widget and the shortcuts go through `showCaptureSheet` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:77) and start listening, so either the dictation hears silence or the meeting's audio stream ends, which reaches «El micrófono dejó de funcionar» and loses the rest of the meeting (inferred; device check).

Fix with one check, where every entry already looks: `voiceAvailableProvider` (App/lib/providers/subscription_provider.dart:59) is false while a meeting records on this phone for the signed-in account. Then the entries' icons become + (notes_screen.dart:308, calendar_screen.dart:1031, task_actions.dart:117, task_editor.dart:930 read it already; don't edit those files), the capture sheet types (`_voice && voiceAvailable`, voice_task_screen.dart:1845, :2346, :4647), and task-page voice edits stay off (task_actions.dart:60).

Where the recording state comes from: `meetingsProvider` (App/lib/widgets/meeting_banners.dart:20) exposes `recording`. Watching `meetingsProvider.select((m) => m.recording != null)` from voiceAvailableProvider is the simplest; but it builds the meeting core (`meetingControllerProvider`) for a signed-in account, so if that makes tests that never used meetings construct it, or breaks them, use a small `meetingHoldsMicProvider` (a StateProvider<bool>, default false) in subscription_provider.dart instead, kept up to date from the app shell, where `meetingsProvider` is already read (App/lib/main.dart:~431). Choose the one that keeps the whole suite passing with no new overrides in unrelated tests; say which in your notes. Don't edit meeting_banners.dart or the meeting services.

Make sure the free-dictation notices don't fire for this: `freeVoiceUsedUpProvider` and `freeVoiceLeftProvider` don't change, and a Pro account during a meeting never sees a used-up or Pro message from an entry. `opensFormProvider` (typesInForm && !voiceAvailable) is unaffected for Pro (typesInForm is false with Pro).

In the capture sheet, when it opens typing because a meeting records, show one line above the text field, in onSurfaceVariant: ES «Se está grabando una reunión: escribe aquí.» / EN “A meeting is recording: type here.” / CA «S’està enregistrant una reunió: escriu aquí.» Never start the recognizer or the sheet's own recorder then. An account without Pro gets the form, as it would with no mic; no line there.

Don't touch: the meeting files, the capture flow when no meeting records (every existing capture test passes unchanged), D3's listening rules, and the regions of voice_task_screen.dart that P318 changes (`_leave`, `_save`'s landing, the review editor's checklist).
acceptance: Pro, signed in, a meeting recording (`meetingsProvider.recording != null`), ES 1×: Notes' «Añadir nota» shows the + icon, not the mic; tapping it opens the capture sheet typing, with «Se está grabando una reunión: escribe aquí.» above the field, and the fake recognizer and recorder are never started.
Same state: Calendar's «Añadir tarea», and a widget or shortcut voice entry (`askedToSpeak: true`), open the sheet typing with the same line, no listening, and no free-dictation or Pro notice.
When the recording stops (`recording` becomes null), the entries show the mic again, and «Añadir tarea» opens the sheet listening as before.
With no meeting recording, every test in App/test/capture_sheet_test.dart passes unchanged.
deviceChecks: Phone: record a meeting, then tap the home-screen widget's mic and Notes' «Añadir nota»: each opens typing with the line, the meeting's time keeps running, and the meeting's notes later include what was said after the attempt (no «El micrófono dejó de funcionar»).

packages.title: Signing out with a meeting: a clear question, Discard set apart, a visible wait that finishes even if you leave, and failures that say what to do
brief: Context: Cuenta › Cerrar sesión with a meeting running, stopped or waiting asks `meetingSignOutQuestion` (App/lib/screens/account_screen.dart:101-117, `_signOutWithMeetings` :150-213), then «Enviar primero» stops a running recording, finishes stopped ones, and `uploadNow()` (App/lib/services/meeting_controller.dart:299-317) waits up to 2 minutes of retries beyond the upload. Keep MN-13: a recording is never dropped silently, and a send that can't finish keeps the account signed in (account_screen.dart:196-207).

UX-2804 (S2), the question: give the dialog a title, ES «¿Cerrar sesión?» / EN “Sign out?” / CA «Vols tancar la sessió?» (new key; TalkBack then opens with it, not «Alerta»). Body: when a meeting is recording now, ES «Estás grabando una reunión. Se parará y se harán sus notas antes de cerrar sesión.» / EN “You’re recording a meeting. It stops, and its notes are made before you sign out.” / CA «Estàs enregistrant una reunió. S’aturarà i se’n faran les notes abans de tancar la sessió.» Otherwise (and, after that sentence, for any other meetings also waiting), the count as a plural: =1 ES «Las notas de una reunión aún no están listas, y su grabación solo está en este teléfono.» / EN “A meeting’s notes aren’t ready yet, and its recording is only on this phone.” / CA «Les notes d’una reunió encara no estan a punt, i l’enregistrament només és en aquest telèfon.»; other ES «Las notas de {count} reuniones aún no están listas, y sus grabaciones solo están en este teléfono.» / EN “The notes of {count} meetings aren’t ready yet, and their recordings are only on this phone.” / CA «Les notes de {count} reunions encara no estan a punt, i els enregistraments només són en aquest telèfon.» Keep the reminders sentence that ends today's `meetingSignOutQuestion` in each language. The primary button becomes ES «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión» / EN “Save notes and sign out” / CA «Desa les notes i tanca la sessió» (`meetingSendFirst`'s text); «Descartar y cerrar sesión» stays. Count the recording apart from the others (account_screen.dart:113-117).

UX-2805 (S2), the order: today the actions are Cancelar, Descartar y cerrar sesión, Enviar primero (`actionsOverflowButtonSpacing: 8`, account_screen.dart:158-174), so the red, irreversible one sits 8 dp above the filled primary. Order them Descartar y cerrar sesión, Cancelar, then the primary: Cancel separates the two in the stacked and the side-by-side layouts.

UX-2802 (S3), the wait: while sending, the only status is the spinner's TalkBack label `meetingSending` (account_screen.dart:409-416). Show a line under «Cerrar sesión», in onSurfaceVariant, from the moment «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión» is tapped until sign-in shows or the send fails: ES «Guardando las notas de la reunión… Puede tardar unos minutos. Después se cerrará la sesión.» / EN “Saving your meeting’s notes… This can take a few minutes. Then you’ll be signed out.” / CA «Desant les notes de la reunió… Pot trigar uns minuts. Després es tancarà la sessió.» Keep the spinner and its label.

UX-2803 (S2), leaving mid-send: the sign-out's last step is `ref.read(authProvider.notifier).signOut()` after the awaits (account_screen.dart:145, :212); after the screen is popped, Riverpod throws «Cannot use "ref" after the widget was disposed», `_run` swallows it, and the confirmed sign-out never happens (on the Discard path the recordings are already gone). Read `authProvider.notifier` and the meeting controller before the first await, in both `_signOut` (:101-146) and `_signOutWithMeetings`, and call them through those references, so a confirmed sign-out finishes even if the person leaves Cuenta. Every setState stays behind `mounted`. If the send fails with the screen gone, nothing more happens: the account stays, and the Notes line already says why the recording waits. Back stays an ordinary way to leave; it doesn't cancel.

UX-2806 (S2), failures: (a) `uploadNow()` returns why it stopped (for example an enum: done, offline, slow — the 2-minute cap at meeting_controller.dart:313 — or blocked), instead of a bool; keep its loop as it is. (b) `meetingSendFailure` (App/lib/widgets/meeting_banners.dart:82-92) splits the generic case: offline — ES «Sin conexión, no se pudieron hacer las notas. Sigues con la sesión abierta; vuelve a tocar Cerrar sesión cuando tengas conexión.» / EN “No connection, so the notes couldn’t be made. You’re still signed in; tap Sign out again once you’re online.” / CA «Sense connexió, no s’han pogut fer les notes. Continues amb la sessió oberta; torna a tocar Tanca la sessió quan tinguis connexió.» (`meetingSendFailed`'s new text); slow — ES «Las notas están tardando más de lo normal. Sigues con la sesión abierta; vuelve a probar Cerrar sesión en unos minutos.» / EN “The notes are taking longer than usual. You’re still signed in; try Sign out again in a few minutes.” / CA «Les notes estan trigant més del normal. Continues amb la sessió oberta; torna a provar Tanca la sessió d’aquí a uns minuts.» (new key; the Catalan is the organizer's). (c) When every waiting recording is already known to be blocked (lost or expired: `meetingLost`; `proRequired`; `allowanceUsed`) and none is recording, the question's body is the matching reason (`meetingSendFailedLost`, `meetingSendFailedPro`, `meetingSendFailedAllowance`, keeping the reminders sentence after it) and it offers only «Descartar y cerrar sesión» and a filled «Cancelar»: no send that can only fail. (d) When more than one recording waits, the lost message adds ES «Descartar y cerrar sesión borra las {count} grabaciones que esperan.» / EN “Discard and sign out deletes all {count} waiting recordings.” / CA «Descarta i tanca la sessió esborra els {count} enregistraments que esperen.» (new key).

Don't touch: `tellServerBeforeSignOut` (meeting_banners.dart:94 onward) beyond what UX-2803 needs, the plain sign-out question `signOutQuestion` for accounts with no meeting, other meeting_banners.dart cards (P321 and P322 change them), and the rest of meeting_controller.dart (P323, P324, P325 change other methods).

Previews: re-render `meetings/sign-out.question.*`; add `meetings/sign-out.recording.es.light.2x` (a meeting recording now), `meetings/sign-out.sending.es.light.2x` (the line while sending), and `meetings/sign-out.blocked.es.light.1x` (one recording held back for Pro: reason body, two buttons).
acceptance: UX-2804: Cuenta › Cerrar sesión with one stopped recording, ES 1× and 2× and CA 2× (360×800): the dialog's title is «¿Cerrar sesión?» and is the first node TalkBack reads; the body starts «Las notas de una reunión aún no están listas, y su grabación solo está en este teléfono.» and ends with the reminders sentence; the primary reads «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión». Nothing is cut at 2×.

UX-2804: with a meeting recording now, the body starts «Estás grabando una reunión. Se parará y se harán sus notas antes de cerrar sesión.»; with three waiting and none recording, it reads «Las notas de 3 reuniones…».

UX-2805: in that dialog at ES 1× and 2×, the actions read, top to bottom when stacked (left to right when not), «Descartar y cerrar sesión», «Cancelar», «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión»; the vertical gap between «Descartar…» and the primary is at least Cancel's height plus the spacing (≥ 56 dp), not 8 dp.

UX-2802: with a slow fake uploader, within 1 s of tapping «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión» the text «Guardando las notas de la reunión… Puede tardar unos minutos. Después se cerrará la sesión.» is visible under «Cerrar sesión»; it goes once sign-in shows, or when the send fails. The spinner keeps its `meetingSending` label.

UX-2803: with a slow fake uploader, tap «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión», pop the Cuenta route, let the uploader finish: the app ends signed out (sign-in shown), with no error thrown. The same for «Descartar y cerrar sesión», and for the plain sign-out that waits on `tellServerBeforeSignOut`.

UX-2806: offline fake: after the send, the message is the offline text and the account is still signed in; slow fake (2-minute cap reached while online): the slow text; one recording lost, or held for Pro, or for the allowance: the question shows that reason and only «Descartar y cerrar sesión» and «Cancelar» (filled), with no «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión».
UX-2806: with two recordings waiting and one lost, the lost message includes «Descartar y cerrar sesión borra las 2 grabaciones que esperan.»
MN-13 holds: in every failing case the account stays signed in and the recordings stay on the phone.
deviceChecks: Phone, offline afternoon with a long recording waiting: Cuenta › Cerrar sesión › «Guardar notas y cerrar sesión»: the line shows while it works; press Back during the wait, and the phone still ends signed out once the notes are saved (or stays signed in, with the Notes line saying why, if they can't be).

packages.title: Meeting lengths in words, the meeting's date and to-dos first on its note, and TalkBack names for the time and «Abrir»
brief: UX-2705 (S2), lengths read as clock times: `meetingElapsed` (App/lib/l10n/meeting_copy.dart:41-48) gives «1:42:00», used in prose and TalkBack names («Se detuvo en 1:42:00», in Catalan literally «a 1:42:00»; «Grabando una reunión · 12:03» reads as noon), and the note's chapters use `meetingClock` (App/lib/services/meeting_note.dart:66-71, :103), «0:30–0:52 Precio del piloto». Keep `meetingElapsed` only for the recording screen's big counter (meeting_screen.dart:505-512). Add a length formatter in meeting_copy.dart, for example `meetingLength(AppLocalizations l, Duration d)`: ES/EN/CA «1 h 42 min», «2 h», «12 min»; under a minute ES «menos de 1 min» / EN “under 1 min” / CA «menys d’1 min» (new key). Use it at meeting_banners.dart:241 (`meetingRecordingNow`, which then reads «Grabando una reunión · 12 min»), :262 (the stopped card's `time`, which also feeds its TalkBack names) and :308 (`meetingDiscardNamed`). P322 rewrites the stopped card next; change only the `time` value there.

UX-2705, chapters: chapter lines become ES «Minutos 0–30 · Presentaciones y alcance» / EN “Minutes 0–30 · …” / CA «Minuts 0–30 · …» while the range ends within the first hour, and lengths past it: «1 h 30 min – 2 h · …» (the same in all three). Build them from the meeting's language (`meetingLocalizations`, meeting_copy.dart:23) through `MeetingNoteLabels` (meeting_note.dart:9-35), with new keys for the minutes ranges.

UX-2710 (S2), the meeting's date: «Enviar el presupuesto · Miki · el viernes» (meeting_note.dart:73-76) reads a week later with no date anywhere, and goes on into the task's checklist. Open the note's body with the meeting's own line, in the meeting's language, built from the meeting's `startedAt` and its length: ES «Reunión del mar, 3 nov, 10:15 · 52 min» / EN “Meeting on Tue, 3 Nov, 10:15 · 52 min” / CA «Reunió del dt., 3 de nov., 10:15 · 52 min» (new key with {date} and {length}; the weekday and month abbreviations come from the locale's date format, with the app's 24-hour time). Pass `startedAt` and the recorded length into `meetingNote` from its caller (App/lib/services/meeting_store.dart:805), in local time. The line comes before the «start missing» line (MN-28) and the summary. The server's part (giving «when» as an absolute day) is out of scope (Backend).

UX-2708 (S2), to-dos last: the note's to-dos (its steps) start below the whole body, every chapter included (render `meetings/note.create-task.es.light.1x`); TalkBack reads the body as one «Tu nota» node with «PASOS · 0/3» off screen. Note bodies are plain text, on every device and the server, so they don't get headings (settled here: adding a format to notes is a new concept). Instead, on a note's page (task_detail_screen.dart:441-500), the steps section comes before «Tu nota» (the body): title, steps, then the body. Tasks keep today's order (notes, reminder, steps). In meeting_note.dart keep the order date line, summary, «Decisiones», «Preguntas abiertas», then «Partes de la reunión» and the chapters last, each label on its own line as now.

UX-2718 (S1), TalkBack: the recording screen's time is read as «12:03» (meeting_screen.dart:505-512): give it the semantics label ES «12 minutos y 3 segundos grabados» / EN “12 minutes 3 seconds recorded” / CA «12 minuts i 3 segons enregistrats», with hours when there are any (ES «1 hora, 4 minutos y 5 segundos grabados», EN “1 hour 4 minutes 5 seconds recorded”, CA «1 hora, 4 minuts i 5 segons enregistrats»), singular forms through ICU plurals; still not a live region (it is read on demand). The Notes recording line's «Abrir» (meeting_banners.dart:243-246) gets the semantics label ES «Abrir la grabación» / EN “Open the recording” / CA «Obre l’enregistrament», like the other line buttons (`_action`, :226).

Don't touch: anything else in meeting_screen.dart (P322, P323 and P324 change its stages), the stopped card's text and buttons (P322), the note page's bottom bar (P318), `meetingNoteLabels`'s existing labels' text, and the stored note format beyond the new first line and the chapter lines.
Previews: re-render `meetings/notes-lines.*`, `meetings/recording.listening.*`, `meetings/note.create-task.*` (ES 1×/2×, CA 2×) and `notes/note.with-steps.es.light.1x` (its steps now come first).
acceptance: UX-2705: unit tests for the length formatter in EN, ES and CA: 0:45 → «menos de 1 min» (ES), 12:03 → «12 min», 1:42:00 → «1 h 42 min», 2:00:00 → «2 h».

UX-2705: the Notes recording line at ES 1× with 12 min 3 s recorded reads «Grabando una reunión · 12 min»; no text on the Notes lines or their TalkBack names contains a clock-like length such as «1:42:00» or «12:03».

UX-2705: a meeting note with chapters 0–30, 30–52 and 90–120 minutes has the lines «Minutos 0–30 · …», «Minutos 30–52 · …» and «1 h 30 min – 2 h · …» in Spanish, «Minuts 0–30 · …» in Catalan, “Minutes 0–30 · …” in English.

UX-2710: `meetingNote` for a Spanish meeting started Tue 3 Nov 2026 10:15 local, 52 min long, begins its body with a line containing «Reunión del», «3», «nov», «10:15» and «52 min»; the Catalan one with «Reunió del» and «10:15 · 52 min»; the English one with “Meeting on” and “10:15 · 52 min”.

UX-2708: on a meeting note's page at ES 1× on 360×800 (`meetings/note.create-task.es.light.1x`), the first step is visible without scrolling and sits above «Tu nota»; on a task's page the notes still come before the steps.

UX-2718: on the recording screen with 12 min 3 s recorded, the time's semantics label is «12 minutos y 3 segundos grabados» (ES) and the screen still shows «12:03» large; on the Notes recording line, «Abrir»'s semantics label is «Abrir la grabación».

packages.title: The stopped-recording card: which meeting, one main choice and Discard set apart; a quieter «Grabar una reunión»; no promise of a notification that can't arrive
brief: Builds on P321 (its `meetingLength` formatter and the stopped card's `time` value in words).

UX-2703 (S3), the stopped card (`MeetingStoppedCard`, App/lib/widgets/meeting_banners.dart:254-285; renders `meetings/notes-lines.stopped-and-waiting.es.light.1x` and `after-stop.microphone-failed.es.light.1x`): today three identical teal text buttons, «Descartar», «Terminar», «Continuar», under «Tu grabación se detuvo en 1:42:00. ¿Continuar, terminar o descartar?», with nothing saying which meeting it is. Replace the line with which meeting and what happened, from the meeting's `startedAt` (on `Meeting`) and its recorded length: ES «Grabación de hoy, 10:15 · 1 h 42 min. Se cortó antes de que pulsaras Parar.» / EN “Recording from today, 10:15 · 1 h 42 min. It stopped before you pressed Stop.” / CA «Enregistrament d’avui, 10:15 · 1 h 42 min. S’ha tallat abans que premessis Atura.» For other days: yesterday ES «Grabación de ayer, 10:15» / EN “Recording from yesterday, 10:15” / CA «Enregistrament d’ahir, 10:15»; older ES «Grabación del {date}, 10:15» / EN “Recording from {date}, 10:15” / CA «Enregistrament del {date}, 10:15», with {date} the app's short weekday date (App/lib/l10n/region.dart). Use separate keys for the «which recording» part and the «· {length}. Se cortó…» sentence; `meetingStoppedAt` goes out of use (remove it from the three catalogs).

UX-2703, the buttons, in this order: a filled ES «Hacer las notas» / EN “Make the notes” / CA «Fes les notes» (new key `meetingMakeNotes`; P324 reuses it) that finishes the meeting into notes (`finishMeeting`); then «Seguir grabando» (`meetingKeepRecording`) as a text button, which continues it; then «Descartar» in the error colour, set apart (after a gap, or on its own line when stacked), which still asks first. TalkBack names, with the length in words: ES «Hacer las notas de la grabación de {time}» / EN “Make the notes from the recording of {time}” / CA «Fes les notes de l’enregistrament de {time}» (`meetingFinishNamed`'s new text); ES «Seguir grabando la grabación de {time}» reads badly, so `meetingContinueNamed` becomes ES «Seguir grabando, {time} hasta ahora» / EN “Keep recording, {time} so far” / CA «Continua enregistrant, {time} fins ara»; `meetingDiscardNamed` unchanged. `meetingFinish` («Terminar») and `meetingContinue` («Continuar») go out of use here; remove them if nothing else uses them. «Terminar» in the capture sheet (`captureFinish`) is untouched.
UX-2703, the meeting screen after a microphone failure (render `after-stop.microphone-failed`): keep only the banner's cause, then the same three buttons, without a second «it stopped» sentence.

UX-2714 (S2), «Descartar»: (a) remove it from the «Preparando tus notas…» card (`_WaitingCard`, meeting_banners.dart:287-325, when the meeting has no problem): it lasts seconds, and the meeting screen and sign-out still offer it; (b) on every surface «Descartar» uses the error colour (the waiting cards' `_action`, which is teal today; meeting_screen.dart:403-409 and :678-690 already are); (c) the meeting screen's allowance-used state gets the same «Descartar» as its Notes card (meeting_screen.dart:650 shows `_AfterActions` only when lost or proRequired); (d) in `_AfterActions` (meeting_screen.dart:656-695) align «Ver Pro» (60 dp) and «Descartar» (48 dp) on their centre line.

UX-2707 (S2), «Grabar una reunión» tops the Notes tab (App/lib/screens/notes_screen.dart:189-206), above search, the project filter, the notes and the empty state's «Un lugar para tus ideas». Move the row to the end of the list content: after the last note, or after the empty state when there are none, so it sits just above «Añadir nota». Keep its conditions (`!readOnly && !recording`) and its key `record-meeting`, and let its icon scale with the text, capped as the tab's other list icons are (at 2× it stays 18 dp beside 28 dp text today). Whether free accounts see it at all is UX-2719, open: it keeps showing to everyone. MeetingBanners (the meeting lines) stay where they are, near the top.

UX-2801 (S3), the copy part: the meeting screen promises «te avisaremos» (`meetingPreparingHelp`, `meetingWaitingConnectionHelp`, meeting_screen.dart:646), but with notifications off (D2: reminders are off by default, and only reminders ask) nothing can arrive. When the phone's notifications are off for TaskFlow — `ref.read(reminderAccessProvider).capability()` (App/lib/providers/reminder_provider.dart:13), `allowed` false — show instead: preparing ES «Tarda unos segundos. Puedes salir de esta pantalla: las notas aparecerán en Notas.» / EN “It takes a few seconds. You can leave this screen: the notes will be in Notes.” / CA «Triga uns segons. Pots sortir d’aquesta pantalla: les notes apareixeran a Notes.»; waiting for connection ES «La grabación está a salvo en el teléfono. Las notas se preparan en cuanto vuelvas a tener conexión, y aparecerán en Notas.» / EN “Your recording is safe on this phone. The notes are made once you’re back online, and they’ll be in Notes.” / CA «L’enregistrament és segur al telèfon. Les notes es preparen quan tornis a tenir connexió, i apareixeran a Notes.» (two new keys). With notifications on, today's copy stays. Asking for the permission at the first meeting is D3 (UX-2813), open: add no request.

Don't touch: `openMeetingRecorder` and the starting, refused and recording stages of meeting_screen.dart (P323), `_stop` and `_follow` (P324), the sign-out copy and `meetingSendFailure` in meeting_banners.dart (P320), the recording line's «Abrir» label (P321).

Previews: re-render `meetings/notes-lines.*` (ES 1×/2×, CA 2×), `meetings/after-stop.*` (pro-required, allowance-used, microphone-failed), `notes/notes-tab.empty.*` and `notes/notes-tab.list.*`; add `meetings/after-stop.preparing-no-notifications.es.light.1x` (the copy without the promise).
acceptance: UX-2703: Notes with a recording that stopped by itself today at 10:15 after 1 h 42 min, ES 1× (360×800): the card reads «Grabación de hoy, 10:15 · 1 h 42 min. Se cortó antes de que pulsaras Parar.»; its buttons are a FilledButton «Hacer las notas», then «Seguir grabando», then «Descartar» in the error colour; no «Terminar», «Continuar» or question sentence. «Hacer las notas» calls `finishMeeting`; «Seguir grabando» opens the recorder to continue; «Descartar» asks first.

UX-2703: a recording stopped yesterday reads «Grabación de ayer, …»; an older one «Grabación del <weekday date>, …». At ES 2× and CA 2× nothing is cut, and «Descartar» is the last button, apart from the filled one.
UX-2703: TalkBack names on the card carry the length in words («Hacer las notas de la grabación de 1 h 42 min»).
UX-2703: the meeting screen after a microphone failure shows the cause once and the same three buttons, with no second «it stopped» sentence.

UX-2714: the «Preparando tus notas…» card has no button; the «Esperando conexión» card's «Descartar» uses the error colour; the meeting screen in the allowance-used state offers «Descartar»; in `after-stop.pro-required.es.light.1x` «Ver Pro» and «Descartar» share a centre line (±1 dp).

UX-2707: Notes with no notes, ES 1× and 2×: «Un lugar para tus ideas» comes before «Grabar una reunión», and «Grabar una reunión» is the last item of the list. With notes: the search field and the first note come before it. At 2× its icon is larger than at 1×.

UX-2801: with the fake ReminderAccess reporting notifications not allowed, the meeting screen while preparing reads «Tarda unos segundos. Puedes salir de esta pantalla: las notas aparecerán en Notas.» and, offline, the connection text ending «y aparecerán en Notas.»; no «te avisaremos». With notifications allowed, today's two texts show.
deviceChecks: Phone, Android 13+, TaskFlow's notifications off: record, Stop: the screen says the notes will be in Notes, not «te avisaremos».

packages.title: Opening and starting a recording: the screen answers at once, buying Pro goes straight on, a refused microphone can be allowed, and the screen says what keeps going
brief: Builds on P321 (the recording screen's time label at meeting_screen.dart:505-512; leave it as P321 left it).

UX-2715 (S2) and UX-2808 (S2), settled together here: `openMeetingRecorder` (App/lib/screens/meeting_screen.dart:27-60) waits up to 5 s for billing with nothing on screen, so a second tap stacks two screens (the Notes button at notes_screen.dart:202-204 has no guard), and after a free account buys Pro on the Pro screen it just returns (:48-53), so the person must go back to Notas and tap again. New flow: push `MeetingScreen` at once, in the same frame as the tap, and ignore further calls while one is opening or open (a guard inside meeting_screen.dart, so notes_screen.dart doesn't change). On the screen's existing «starting» stage (its spinner), wait for billing as now (up to 5 s). Without Pro, push the Pro screen (`/subscription`, `ProReason.meetingNotes`) over the meeting screen and await it: if Pro is active when it closes, go straight on to starting the recording (microphone permission, then recording); if not, pop the meeting screen at once, so Back from the Pro screen lands on Notas as today. This replaces the reviewer's pushReplacement idea, because it also lets a purchase go straight on (UX-2808). A recording already running, and «Seguir grabando» on a stopped one (`continueId`), open as today.

UX-2712 (S2), refused or failed start (`_Refused`, meeting_screen.dart:533-561; renders `recording.microphone-refused.es.light.1x`, `recording.start-failed.es.light.2x`): (a) distinguish a microphone refused but still askable from one blocked, as the capture sheet does (`SpeechPermission` granted/denied/blocked, App/lib/services/native_speech.dart:32; voice_task_screen.dart:1165-1185): extend the recorder engine's permission check (`hasPermission`, App/lib/services/meeting_recorder.dart:33, implemented in App/lib/services/meeting_audio.dart:101, used at meeting_controller.dart:234) to report which, and update the fakes. Refused but askable: ES «Para grabar una reunión, TaskFlow necesita el micrófono.» / EN “To record a meeting, TaskFlow needs the microphone.” / CA «Per enregistrar una reunió, TaskFlow necessita el micròfon.» (new key; the organizer's copy) with a filled ES «Permitir el micrófono» / EN “Allow the microphone” / CA «Permet el micròfon» (new key) that asks again and starts when allowed. Blocked: today's `meetingMicrophoneBlocked` with «Abrir Ajustes». (b) When the app resumes on the refused screen, check again, and start recording on its own once allowed. (c) Start failed («No se pudo empezar a grabar. Inténtalo de nuevo.»): a filled «Reintentar» (`tryAgain`: ES «Reintentar», EN “Try again”, CA «Torna-ho a provar») that tries to start again. Low space keeps its message with no button.

UX-2711 (S2), the month's time or Pro learned only after Stop: `_canRecord` (meeting_controller.dart:224-237) checks space, permission and busy, and the recording screen (meeting_screen.dart:455-531) shows no upload problem while it records, although the uploader marks `allowanceUsed` or `proRequired` on the meeting as pieces are refused (meeting_uploader.dart:296, :338). (a) While recording, once the current meeting has `allowanceUsed` or `proRequired`, show the same line its Notes card shows (`meetingWaitingLine`: `meetingAllowanceUsed`, `meetingProRequired`) under the time, styled like `meetingSpaceLowWarning` (:515-522). Recording goes on. (b) When the account already has a meeting refused for the allowance this month (any meeting on this phone with `allowanceUsed` whose refusal falls in the current calendar month), show from the first frame of recording: ES «Has usado el tiempo de reuniones de este mes: puedes grabar, y las notas llegarán el mes que viene.» / EN “You’ve used this month’s meeting time: you can record, and the notes come next month.” / CA «Has fet servir el temps de reunions d’aquest mes: pots enregistrar, i les notes arribaran el mes que ve.» (new key). Expose what the screen needs from the controller's state; don't change what the uploader sends or stores.

UX-2716 (S2), leaving: the ← leaves the recording running with no word about it. `meetingListeningHelp` (meeting_screen.dart:522-527) becomes ES «Puedes salir o bloquear el teléfono: sigue grabando hasta que pulses Parar.» / EN “You can leave or lock the phone: it keeps recording until you press Stop.” / CA «Pots sortir o bloquejar el telèfon: continua enregistrant fins que premis Atura.» It must fit above «Parar» without scrolling at ES and CA 2× on 360×800, together with a warning line from UX-2711 when one shows.

Don't touch: `_stop`, `_follow` and the silence rule (P324), the after stage and `_AfterActions` (P322), the time's semantics label (P321), the uploader, the Pro screen itself (P326), MN-6's space checks. A Pro subscriber whose billing is still loading after 5 s is sent to the Pro screen as today (inferred by review D; device check).

Previews: re-render `meetings/recording.*`; add `meetings/recording.allowance-used.es.light.2x` (the line under the time) and `meetings/recording.microphone-askable.es.light.1x` («Permitir el micrófono»).
acceptance: UX-2715: with billing still loading, tapping «Grabar una reunión» shows MeetingScreen (its starting spinner) in the first frame after the tap; two quick taps leave exactly one MeetingScreen on the stack.

UX-2808: a free account: «Grabar una reunión» › the Pro screen (reason meetingNotes) › a fake purchase makes `hasProProvider` true › pop: the meeting screen goes on to recording (the fake recorder started), with no second tap in Notas.
UX-2808: a free account that leaves the Pro screen without buying: one Back from the Pro screen shows Notas; no MeetingScreen remains on the stack.

UX-2712: microphone denied but askable: the screen shows «Para grabar una reunión, TaskFlow necesita el micrófono.» and a FilledButton «Permitir el micrófono»; tapping it asks again, and a fake grant starts the recording. Blocked: today's message with «Abrir Ajustes». Blocked, then the fake allows it and the app resumes: recording starts with no tap.
UX-2712: start failed: a FilledButton «Reintentar»; tapping it calls start again, and a success shows the recording screen.

UX-2711: recording, the fake uploader refuses a piece for the allowance: within a frame of the refusal the recording screen shows «Has usado el tiempo de reuniones de este mes…» under the time, and recording continues. With an allowance refusal already this month, the start line «Has usado el tiempo de reuniones de este mes: puedes grabar, y las notas llegarán el mes que viene.» shows from the first frame of recording.

UX-2716: the recording screen at ES 1× reads «Puedes salir o bloquear el teléfono: sigue grabando hasta que pulses Parar.»; at ES 2× and CA 2× on 360×800, with and without the allowance line, that line and the whole «Parar» button are visible without scrolling.
deviceChecks: Phone: Android's microphone dialog: a first «No permitir» shows «Permitir el micrófono», which asks again; after a second refusal, «Abrir Ajustes»; allowing in Ajustes and coming back starts recording.
Phone with RevenueCat's test store: a free account › «Grabar una reunión» › buy Pro › close the paywall and the Pro screen: recording starts.
Phone, a Pro account offline at app start (store not ready): «Grabar una reunión» is not sent to the Pro screen within the first seconds (review D, inferred).

packages.title: Stopping: a failed Stop says it's still recording, and a quiet recording asks before it's thrown away
brief: Builds on P322: it reuses `meetingMakeNotes` («Hacer las notas»), which P322 adds; don't add it again.

UX-2713 (S2): a Stop that throws shows `meetingStartFailed`, «No se pudo empezar a grabar. Inténtalo de nuevo.», while it is still recording (App/lib/screens/meeting_screen.dart:253-258). Give it its own string: ES «No se pudo parar. Sigue grabando: vuelve a pulsar Parar.» / EN “Couldn’t stop. It’s still recording: press Stop again.” / CA «No s’ha pogut aturar. Continua enregistrant: torna a prémer Atura.» (new key). The recording screen stays, and «Parar» works again.

UX-2717 (S2): a recording judged all silence is deleted at Stop with only a snackbar, «No se oyó nada, así que no hay nada que guardar.» (meeting_screen.dart:261-266; the rule is −42 dBFS and 3 loud samples per piece, App/lib/services/meeting_recorder.dart:63-64 and :81-82). The rule has never met a real room, and MN-26 says a real meeting is never thrown away silently. Today silent pieces are left out as they're cut, so by Stop nothing is left to ask about. Change: while a meeting has kept no piece with sound yet, the recorder keeps its silent pieces on the phone (not uploaded); once a piece with sound is kept, the silent ones before it are left out as now (MN-4). At Stop, a recording of 60 s or more with no piece with sound isn't deleted: `stop()` returns it marked quiet (meeting_controller.dart:241-246 and the recorder's stop, meeting_recorder.dart:459 onward), and the screen asks, as a dialog: ES «Casi no se oyó nada. ¿Hacer notas igualmente?» / EN “Almost nothing was heard. Make notes anyway?” / CA «Gairebé no s’ha sentit res. Vols fer notes igualment?» (new key), with a filled «Hacer las notas» (`meetingMakeNotes`), which keeps the held pieces and sends them like any piece, then the screen goes on to «Preparando tus notas…», and «Descartar» in the error colour, which deletes them (MN-25) and closes the screen. Dismissing the dialog counts as neither: ask again (it stays a stopped meeting with its card, which offers the same choices via P322). Under 60 s, the silent drop stays as today, with its snackbar. A recording that ended by itself with only silence (out of space, `_follow` :305-316) stays as today.
Don't touch: the piece rules' numbers, what a piece with sound does, `_canRecord` and the start (P323), the recording screen's lines (P323), the after stage and the cards (P322), the uploader.
Previews: add `meetings/after-stop.quiet-question.es.light.1x` (the dialog).
acceptance: UX-2713: on the recording screen, a fake `stop()` that throws shows «No se pudo parar. Sigue grabando: vuelve a pulsar Parar.»; the recording screen stays, and a second «Parar» that succeeds stops it.

UX-2717: a 10-minute fake recording whose levels never pass −42 dBFS: at «Parar» the dialog «Casi no se oyó nada. ¿Hacer notas igualmente?» shows with «Hacer las notas» (filled) and «Descartar»; nothing was deleted before the answer.
UX-2717: «Hacer las notas» keeps the held pieces (they reach the fake uploader) and the screen shows «Preparando tus notas…»; «Descartar» deletes them and closes the screen.
UX-2717: a 30-second silent recording is still dropped at Stop with «No se oyó nada, así que no hay nada que guardar.», as today.
UX-2717: a recording with sound in its third piece keeps that piece and later ones, and leaves out the silent pieces before it, as MN-4 says (recorder unit test).
deviceChecks: Phone: record a quiet conversation with the phone 2–3 m away for a few minutes: is it judged silent? If it is, the question shows at Stop, and «Hacer las notas» gives notes.

packages.title: Meeting notifications: a running clock while recording, the meeting's title first, one per meeting, cleared once read or signed out
brief: UX-2810 (S2): the recording's notification (`meetingRecordingNotificationDetails`, App/lib/services/notification_service.dart:163-200) shows only «Grabando una reunión» with Parar and Descartar: `showWhen: false`, no time. Use Android's own chronometer: `usesChronometer: true`, `showWhen: true`, and `when` = the moment recording would have started for the time already recorded (now minus the recorded time; for «Seguir grabando», the time so far). Carry that instant on `MeetingNotice` (App/lib/services/meeting_recorder.dart:8), set by the recorder each time it posts (start, after each cut, after a continue), and passed through `showMeetingRecording` (notification_service.dart:516, called from App/lib/services/meeting_audio.dart:88). No new string. Everything else about it (silent, low importance, public, content-free title, its buttons) stays.

UX-2812 (S1): «Las notas de tu reunión están listas» is the title, the meeting's title comes second and is cut first, and every meeting uses one id (`meetingNotesNotificationId`, :135; `showMeetingNotesReady`, :544-562), so a second replaces the first. Make the note's title the notification's title and the generic line its text: `meetingNotesReady` becomes ES «Las notas de la reunión están listas» (EN “Your meeting notes are ready” and CA «Les notes de la reunió ja són a punt» are unchanged). With no title, keep today's layout (the generic line as title, no text). Post each meeting's under the same id with the meeting's id as the notification's tag, so each meeting keeps its own; the payload and the tap handling (App/lib/main.dart:385-396) stay as they are.

UX-2811 (S2): nothing cancels the notes-ready notification: opening the note in the app leaves it, and it outlives a sign-out showing the meeting's title, where a tap from the next account is dropped. Add a way to cancel one meeting's (by its tag) and all of them (the active notifications with that id). Cancel one: in `markSeen` (App/lib/services/meeting_controller.dart:286-289), and when that note's page opens (TaskDetailScreen's initState for a note, App/lib/screens/task_detail_screen.dart; a no-op when there is none, and safe in tests where notifications aren't supported). Cancel all: when the reminders' owner changes on sign-out (`TaskReminders.activate`, notification_service.dart, which `_remind('signed-out')` reaches from `AuthNotifier.signOut`), next to where reminders are cancelled.

Don't touch: the recording notification's channel, ids and buttons; `meetingNotesNotified` (notes-ready suppressed while that meeting's screen is in front); reminders' own notifications; the rest of meeting_controller.dart (P320, P323, P324) and task_detail_screen.dart (P318's bottom bar, P321's section order); lock-screen visibility (UX-2814 is open).
acceptance: UX-2810: `meetingRecordingNotificationDetails` for a notice whose recording started 5 minutes ago has `usesChronometer: true`, `showWhen: true` and `when` = that start, in milliseconds since the epoch; a continued meeting with 42 minutes recorded gets `when` = now minus 42 minutes (unit test with a fixed clock).

UX-2812: for a saved note titled «Precio del piloto», `showMeetingNotesReady` posts the title «Precio del piloto» and the text «Las notas de la reunión están listas» (ES); with an empty title, the title «Las notas de la reunión están listas» and no text. Two meetings' notifications use different tags (each meeting's id) under the notes-ready id (unit test on what is posted).

UX-2811: `markSeen(id)` cancels that meeting's notes-ready notification (its tag); opening that note's page cancels it too; signing out cancels every notes-ready notification. Reminders' cancellations are unchanged (unit tests with a fake plugin or driver).
The notes-ready tap still opens the note for the account that recorded it (App/test/meeting_open_note_test.dart passes).
deviceChecks: Phone: record for 6 minutes (one cut at about 5 min), lock the phone: the shade's counter keeps time through the cut and after «Seguir grabando».

Phone: notes ready with the app in the background › open the note from Notas: the notification is gone. Two meetings ready together leave two notifications, each titled with its meeting. Sign out: none remain.

packages.title: The Pro screen for meetings: one heading for both ways in, meeting notes listed as a benefit, and a priced preview
brief: UX-2807 (S2): `billingReasonMeetingNotes` heads the Pro screen for both ways in: «Grabar una reunión» (meeting_screen.dart:49-52) and «Ver Pro» on a recording held back for Pro (meeting_banners.dart:316-320, meeting_screen.dart:675). After Pro lapses, the second is told to «graba una reunión» about a recording already made. One heading that fits both: ES «Con Pro, tus reuniones se convierten en notas:» / EN “With Pro, your meetings become notes:” / CA «Amb Pro, les teves reunions es converteixen en notes:». Keep the example line, but it promises «las tareas» where the notes give to-dos that become one task's steps (review C's cross-slice note): `billingReasonMeetingNotesExample` becomes ES «un resumen, las decisiones y las cosas por hacer» / CA «un resum, les decisions i les coses per fer»; EN “a summary, the decisions and the to-dos” is unchanged. No new reason value.

UX-2809 (S2): the Pro screen's benefit list (App/lib/screens/subscription_screen.dart:174-179) names dictation, typing and reminders only, though meeting notes are Pro-only (the build's default). Add one line: ES «Notas de las reuniones que grabas» / EN “Notes from your recorded meetings” / CA «Notes de les reunions que enregistres» (new key). Hide it when the reason is `meetingNotes`, as the reminders line is hidden for `reminderPlans`. Keep the settled order (reason, plan, benefits, the pinned «Ver suscripción»: UX-2603, UX-2640). The RevenueCat paywall is external (UX-2815, the owner's).

Evidence gap from review D: the preview `meetings/pro.reason` (App/test/ux_previews/meeting_previews.dart:441-453) renders the store-error state (no price, no «Ver suscripción»). Give it the priced offering the reminders preview uses (reminders_previews.dart, `reminders/sheet.pro-screen.*`), and add `meetings/pro.held-back.es.light.1x`: the Pro screen opened from a held-back recording's «Ver Pro».
Don't touch: the Pro screen's layout, other reasons' copy, billing code, `openMeetingRecorder` (P323).
acceptance: UX-2807: the Pro screen opened with reason meetingNotes, ES 1× (priced store): the reason box reads «Con Pro, tus reuniones se convierten en notas:» then «un resumen, las decisiones y las cosas por hacer»; the same text when opened from a held-back recording's «Ver Pro». CA 2×: «Amb Pro, les teves reunions es converteixen en notes:», nothing cut.

UX-2809: the Pro screen from Ajustes (no reason), ES 1× and CA 2× on 360×800: the benefits include «Notas de las reuniones que grabas»; at CA 2× the first benefit still shows above the pinned «Ver suscripción» (as UX-2640 requires). With reason meetingNotes that line is hidden, and with reminderPlans the reminders line is hidden as before.
Preview: `meetings/pro.reason.es.light.1x` shows a price and «Ver suscripción», not «Estado de suscripción no disponible».

decisions.question: Should «Crear tarea» show on every note with an open checklist, or only on notes made from a meeting? (UX-2722, S2; open from the owner context, and review C's question 4.) Today any note with an open step shows it (`noteMakesTask`, App/lib/widgets/note_task.dart:15-16): the croquetas recipe note does (render `notes/note.with-steps.es.light.1x`), which turns a shopping list into a task titled «Receta de la abuela: croquetas de jamón». Options: (a) only notes made from a meeting: the phone marks the note it saves from a meeting (a local mark, nothing new sent); (b) every note with open steps, as now.
decisions.recommendation: (a): the button exists for the meeting's to-dos (MN-22), and on other notes it's an unexplained extra next to «Editar nota». P318 works either way: its «Ver tarea», steps choice and landing don't depend on which notes show the button. One small package after this run.

decisions.question: Should free accounts see «Grabar una reunión» in Notas? (UX-2719, S2; review C's question 1.) Today it shows to everyone, and a free account's tap lands on the Pro screen. Options: (a) Pro only, while meeting notes are Pro-only; the Pro screen still lists meetings as a benefit (P326); (b) everyone, as now; (c) free accounts only after they've used dictation.
decisions.recommendation: (a), as review C recommends: «show advanced things only when relevant», and a paywall behind a Notes-tab row reads as nagging (SU-6). P322 already moves the row below the notes, which holds either way.

decisions.question: Should the app ask for notifications at the first «Grabar una reunión»? (UX-2813, S2; review D's question 4, split from UX-2801.) Without the permission (Android 13+; reminders are off by default, D2 of 2026-10-13), «Las notas de tu reunión están listas» never shows, and the recording's own notification with Parar and Descartar appears only in Android's Task Manager, not the notification drawer. Today only the first dated task's sheet and Ajustes ask. Option (a): at an account's first recording on this phone, if notifications are off, one sentence after the microphone — ES «Para pararla desde la notificación y avisarte cuando las notas estén listas.» / EN “So you can stop it from the notification and hear when the notes are ready.” / CA «Per aturar-lo des de la notificació i avisar-te quan les notes estiguin a punt.» — with one «Continuar», then Android's dialog; never asked again after a refusal. (b) No ask; the copy stops promising a notification when they're off (P322 does that either way).
decisions.recommendation: (a), as review D recommends: the feature depends on its notifications, and asking at the moment of use is the guideline (ON-5, ON-8). It adds a permission request outside D2's sheet, so it's yours. One small package after this run.

decisions.question: Should the app say up front that meetings have a monthly amount (about 20 hours)? (UX-2720, S2; review C's question 2 and review D's question 1, merged.) The build caps meetings at about 20 hours a month (`AI_MEETING_PIECES_PER_MONTH` = 240 pieces); people first hear of it in «Has usado el tiempo de reuniones de este mes». Options: (a) one line on the Pro screen's meeting benefit, for example «Notas de las reuniones que grabas, hasta 20 horas al mes»; (b) say nothing until it bites (P323 now says it while recording, UX-2711).
decisions.recommendation: (a), with the number you choose: a limit stated before purchase avoids a surprise in the middle of a client meeting (SU-7). The number, and whether to keep a cap at all, are yours (MEETING_NOTES.md suggests perhaps 20 hours a month against abuse).

decisions.question: Should the recording screen say what happens to the audio, and remind people to tell the others? (UX-2721, S2; review C's question 3.) The build's default is no consent reminder. The flow also never says the audio is sent to make the notes and then deleted (PR-5). Options: (a) one quiet line under the time: ES «El audio se envía para hacer las notas y después se borra.» (the consent reminder stays off); (b) one line for both: the audio and «avisa a los demás de que grabas»; (c) nothing, as now.
decisions.recommendation: (a): it's true today (MN-15, MN-24) and answers the first worry about recording a conversation, without the consent nudge you left off by default. If you choose (b), the consent part is yours. The website's privacy page must match when the feature ships (MN-34, /ux-web).

decisions.question: Should «Notas listas» hide the meeting's title on the lock screen? (UX-2814, S1; review D's question 3.) Today it shows the meeting's title there, as reminders show task titles (NO-9). A meeting's title can be more personal («Despido de Juan»). Options: (a) private on the lock screen: Android shows «Las notas de la reunión están listas» there, and the title once unlocked; (b) keep it as reminders do.
decisions.recommendation: (a): meeting titles are written by the AI from what was said, so they can carry more than a task title the person typed; it's one notification setting and changes nothing else. Reminders stay as they are.

decisions.question: Will you add meeting notes to the RevenueCat paywall's Pro benefits? (UX-2815, S1; review D's question 2.) The paywall is configured in RevenueCat's dashboard, outside the app; agents don't touch external services (as D7 of 2026-10-22 for «A tu manera»).
decisions.recommendation: Yes, while meetings stay Pro-only: add «Notas de las reuniones que grabas» (EN “Notes from your recorded meetings”, CA «Notes de les reunions que enregistres») to the paywall's benefits yourself. P326 adds the same line to the app's own Pro screen.

notes: Sources: review-C.md (UX-2701–UX-2718, area C: recording, after Stop, the note and its task) and review-D.md (UX-2801–UX-2812, area D: sign-out, notifications and Pro), both read at commit 3efed60. Evidence: code, widget-test renders in App/build/ux/meetings/ and notes/ rendered from that commit, AUDIT.md measurements, and Android's documentation for UX-2801. No device captures this run.

No finding matches an earlier ledger line (meetings are new in 3efed60), so every ID is new. The organizer filed seven owner questions as UX-2719–UX-2722 and UX-2813–UX-2815; UX-2813 is the ask half of UX-2801, whose copy half is a fix (P322).

Out of scope, for the main session: UX-2710's server half (ask the final step to give «when» as an absolute day relative to the meeting's date; Backend/core/ai.py); review D's cross-slice note that the delete-account page doesn't mention recordings still waiting on this phone (`account_deletion.dart` erases them), for a future area D review; and the website's privacy page for recordings (MN-34, /ux-web) when the feature ships.
